title: Gemini 4 Argon: Built to solve your hardest problems
bajada: Google lanzó Gemini 4 Argon, su nuevo modelo de IA diseñado para resolver problemas complejos. La versión incluye capacidades especializadas para robótica, ampliando las aplicaciones empresariales de la plataforma.
bajada_en: Google launched Gemini 4 Argon, its new AI model designed to solve complex problems. The version includes specialized capabilities for robotics, expanding enterprise applications of the platform.

title: Higgsfield takes AI video from 1 minute to over 10
summary: Higgsfield brings creators longer videos with GPT-6 Astra, precise visuals with GPT-Image-2.5, and a path to voice filmmaking with GPT-Live.
title_es: OpenAI y Higgsfield extienden videos de IA a más de 10 minutos
bajada: Higgsfield ahora permite a creadores generar videos más largos usando GPT-6 Astra y GPT-Image-2.5, con camino hacia filmmaking con voz. Esto representa un avance significativo en síntesis de contenido audiovisual de larga duración.
bajada_en: Higgsfield now enables creators to generate longer videos using GPT-6 Astra and GPT-Image-2.5, with a path toward voice filmmaking. This marks a significant advancement in long-form audiovisual synthesis.

title: All Systems Go: Global PC App Ecosystem Ready for NVIDIA RTX Spark
summary: NVIDIA RTX Spark is a new beginning for the PC — a reinvention combining the capabilities of a gaming PC, a creative studio and a personal AI supercomputer into a single superchip. With up to 128GB of unified memory and 1 petaflop of AI compute, RTX Spark delivers the full stack of NVIDIA RTX and […]
title_es: NVIDIA RTX Spark: PC como supercomputadora de IA
bajada: NVIDIA presentó RTX Spark, reinventando las PCs con hasta 128GB de memoria unificada y 1 petaflop de computación de IA. El producto posiciona las computadoras personales como herramientas AI locales y privadas para desarrolladores.
bajada_en: NVIDIA unveiled RTX Spark, reinventing PCs with up to 128GB unified memory and 1 petaflop of AI compute. The product positions personal computers as local, private AI tools for developers.

title: Run fast, private agents on-device with LFM2.5-24B-A2B
title_es: Hugging Face lanza LFM2.5-24B para agentes privados
bajada: LFM2.5-24B-A2B es un modelo de 24B parámetros optimizado para ejecutar agentes de IA rápidos y privados directamente en dispositivos. Ideal para desarrolladores que buscan privacidad sin comprometer velocidad.
bajada_en: LFM2.5-24B-A2B is a 24B parameter model optimized to run fast, private AI agents directly on-device. Ideal for developers seeking privacy without sacrificing speed.

title: OpenAI Eyes Acquisition That Could Boost Cybersecurity Business
summary: OpenAI, which is trying to develop a substantial cybersecurity business, is in early talks to buy Trail of Bits, a firm that finds and fixes vulnerabilities in open-source software, according to people familiar with the matter.The size of the potential deal couldn’t be learned. OpenAI has sometimes paid in thelow hundreds of millions of dollarsin the form of stock to acquire small startups, though it sometimes pays less. Discussions are ongoing and the deal could fall apart, said the people.
title_es: OpenAI negocia adquisición de Trail of Bits
bajada: OpenAI está en conversaciones iniciales para adquirir Trail of Bits, una firma especializada en encontrar y corregir vulnerabilidades en software open-source. El movimiento refuerza la estrategia de ciberseguridad de OpenAI.
bajada_en: OpenAI is in early talks to acquire Trail of Bits, a firm specializing in finding and fixing vulnerabilities in open-source software. The move reinforces OpenAI's cybersecurity strategy.

title: Shopify opens its catalog up to more AI agents
summary: More AI agents will soon be able to browse and purchase from Shopify listings, marking an expansion of the company's agentic commerce ambitions. Shopify announced Tuesday it will let shoppers configure their AI agents to purchase products on their behalf, giving more agents access to over a billion listings in Shopify's catalog. (The catalog consists […]
title_es: Shopify abre su catálogo a más agentes de IA
bajada: Shopify expandió el acceso a su catálogo de más de mil millones de productos para que agentes de IA puedan hacer compras automáticas. Esto marca un paso importante hacia el comercio agentic en e-commerce.
bajada_en: Shopify expanded access to its catalog of over one billion products so AI agents can make autonomous purchases. This marks an important step toward agentic commerce in e-commerce.

title: OpenAI and Anthropic Tell British Lawmakers: Regulate Us
summary: AI leaders joined whistleblowers and security leaders at a sweeping parliamentary session, while a few hundred meters away Britain’s spy chief warned AI could be used to create new bioweapons.
title_es: OpenAI y Anthropic piden regulación a legisladores británicos
bajada: Líderes de IA, incluyendo OpenAI y Anthropic, se presentaron ante el Parlamento británico abogando por regulación de IA. El evento ocurrió mientras autoridades de seguridad advertían sobre riesgos de armas biológicas.
bajada_en: AI leaders, including OpenAI and Anthropic, appeared before British Parliament advocating for AI regulation. The event occurred as security officials warned about bioweapon risks.

title: Character.ai Files for Bankruptcy
bajada: Character.ai, plataforma de chatbots de IA, presentó quiebra. El colapso refleja desafíos comerciales en el segmento de aplicaciones de IA conversacional dirigidas al consumidor.
bajada_en: Character.ai, an AI chatbot platform, filed for bankruptcy. The collapse reflects commercial challenges in the consumer-focused conversational AI application segment.

title: Open models have real benefits. Do they outweigh the risks?
summary: MIT Technology Review Explains: Let our writers untangle the complex, messy world of science and technology to help you understand what’s coming next. You can read more from the series here. Late last month, Anthropic released a report arguing that the model GLM-5.3 poses a major cyberattack risk. The report’s core concern is that the…
title_es: Debate: ¿Beneficios de modelos abiertos vs. riesgos?
bajada: MIT Technology Review analiza si los beneficios de los modelos abiertos de IA superan sus riesgos, incluyendo preocupaciones de ciberseguridad planteadas por Anthropic sobre GLM-5.3. El debate es central para el futuro de la gobernanza de IA.
bajada_en: MIT Technology Review analyzes whether AI open models' benefits outweigh their risks, including cybersecurity concerns raised by Anthropic about GLM-5.3. The debate is central to the future of AI governance.

title: Judge orders OpenAI to turn over hiring records in Apple trade secrets case
summary: A federal judge ruled that Apple can access OpenAI's interview materials involving former Apple employees, as well as private messages and testimony from key figures in the case.
title_es: Juez ordena a OpenAI entregar registros de contratación
bajada: Un juez federal ordenó a OpenAI entregar materiales de entrevistas de empleados anteriores de Apple en un caso de secretos comerciales. La decisión afecta la privacidad de procesos de selección en la industria tech.
bajada_en: A federal judge ordered OpenAI to turn over interview materials from former Apple employees in a trade secrets case. The decision impacts privacy in tech hiring processes.

title: OpenAI employee arrested for allegedly planting a bug in a conference room
summary: An OpenAI engineer was arrested after the company said it discovered a "sophisticated recording device" hidden in one of its offices. The employee was identified as Abdulrahman Alfozan, a 35-year-old Saudi national. Alfozan is charged with using or endeavoring to use a device to intercept oral communications, according to a press release from the Department […]
title_es: Arrestado ingeniero de OpenAI por colocar dispositivo espía
bajada: Un ingeniero de OpenAI fue arrestado tras descubrirse un sofisticado dispositivo de grabación en sus oficinas. El incidente plantea preocupaciones de seguridad y espionaje corporativo en empresas de IA.
bajada_en: An OpenAI engineer was arrested after a sophisticated recording device was discovered in the company's offices. The incident raises corporate espionage and security concerns in AI companies.

title: An OpenAI Employee Allegedly Used a Chatbot to Help Plant a Recording Device at the Office
summary: Chatbot prompts reveal the engineer’s alleged efforts to set up a covert listening device days before one was found in a meeting room used by high-level executives.
title_es: Chatbot supuestamente ayudó a ingeniero a plantar micrófono
bajada: Investigaciones revelan que un ingeniero de OpenAI usó chatbots para ayudarse a instalar un dispositivo de escucha en la oficina. El caso ilustra riesgos de seguridad no considerados en herramientas de IA.
bajada_en: Investigations reveal an OpenAI engineer allegedly used chatbots to help install a listening device at the office. The case illustrates unforeseen security risks in AI tools.

title: Gemini 4 Argon for Robotics
title_es: Gemini 4 Argon para robótica disponible para developers
bajada: Google publicó detalles específicos sobre Gemini 4 Argon optimizado para robótica. La especialización permite a desarrolladores integrar modelos de IA avanzados en sistemas robóticos.
bajada_en: Google published specific details about Gemini 4 Argon optimized for robotics. The specialization enables developers to integrate advanced AI models in robotic systems.

title: Industrial Next wants factory robots to switch tasks in minutes, not weeks
summary: Industrial Next helps manufacturers automate complex, delicate tasks that have traditionally required human labor.
title_es: Industrial Next acelera adaptación de robots de fábrica
bajada: Industrial Next desarrolla soluciones para que robots de fábrica cambien tareas en minutos en lugar de semanas. La tecnología automatiza procesos delicados que tradicionalmente requieren trabajo humano.
bajada_en: Industrial Next develops solutions for factory robots to switch tasks in minutes instead of weeks. The technology automates delicate processes that traditionally require human labor.

title: Gemini 4 Argon
title_es: Gemini 4 Argon gana atención en comunidad developer
bajada: El lanzamiento de Gemini 4 Argon generó gran engagement en Hacker News con cientos de comentarios. La comunidad developer muestra interés significativo en las capacidades del nuevo modelo.
bajada_en: Gemini 4 Argon launch generated high engagement on Hacker News with hundreds of comments. The developer community shows significant interest in the model's capabilities.
